Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Jeff Chandler is credited on 90 distinct recordings across 15 programs from 1946-07-10 through 1957-03-31. Documented roles include performer on 90 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Michael Shayne (performer on 30 recordings; 30 distinct recordings), Frontier Town (performer on 22 recordings; 22 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 11 recordings; 11 distinct recordings), Screen Directors Playhouse (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), The Damon Runyon Theatre (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), and Academy Award Theater (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Michael Shayne (30 portrayals) and Chad Remington (22 portrayals).
